purpose: The patch modifies device‑property fwnode APIs to accept error‑pointer values, removing the need for callers to test IS_ERR before fwnode_handle_put(), thus simplifying error handling and avoiding reference‑count leaks.
Updates the QCOM QMP PHY device tree binding documentation to correct the child node description, changing it from per‑lane to per‑PHY.
The commit introduces basic code structures in the AMD display driver to support Firmware Assisted Memory Switching, laying groundwork for future activation of this capability.
The patch adds an #ifdef around two X86‑specific lines in drm/ttm so they are excluded when building for ARCH=um, enabling successful compilation under user‑mode Linux where PCI is emulated.
The patch adds the const qualifier to pointers of struct qcom_icc_bcm in the SC8280XP interconnect driver, indicating they are never modified, while keeping the struct contents mutable.
The patch corrects the handling of 64‑bit arguments in SBI PMU calls when compiled for RV32, ensuring the proper registers are used so that RV32 kernels set correct values.
The commit replaces direct accesses to the perf CPU map with calls to the perf_cpu_map API, improving reference‑count handling and code consistency.

The patch refactors DMA allocation/free paths to insert a tracepoint that records the actual allocating function, enabling tracing of DMA allocations and detection of misuse such as freeing before unmapping.

The patch restructures the cs42l42 driver probe and remove functions into three stages to accommodate SoundWire devices, adding an init_done flag to guard against register accesses when initialization failed.
Adds a device‑tree node for the Qualcomm SC7280 Data Capture and Compare (DCC) hardware, specifying its register address, enabling kernel support for the DCC block.

The patch updates iwlwifi driver code to correctly remove const qualifiers by casting through uintptr_t or de‑constifying variables, and removes unnecessary void* casts for dma_map_single, ensuring compilation on stricter compilers.

The patch refactors the s390 vfio_ap driver to obtain queue devices via the AP bus's ap_get_qdev() function, using a hashtable keyed by APQN instead of iterating over the device list, yielding a faster lookup.

Corrects NFSv4.2 CLONE handling for zero‑length clones. With a delegation the client skipped attribute updates, causing the destination inode size to be set to zero. The patch computes the correct size from the server's GETATTR after CLONE.

The commit adds support for retrieving the Signal‑to‑Noise Ratio from the wcn36xx driver by introducing a macro (from the prima driver) and implementing the get_snr() helper, enabling future use in mac80211 survey operations.
The patch updates RAID5 stripe_head code to fully initialize embedded bio structures via bio_init, replacing prior partial init, manual field settings, and bio_reset.
The patch removes an unnecessary backslash at the end of a line in the spr_cstates[] array definition of the intel_idle driver, cleaning up the source without altering functionality.
Adds CONFIG_OBJTOOL, makes stack validation optional, replaces CONFIG_STACK_VALIDATION usages, and redefines config semantics for objtool.

The patch changes the driver’s variable declarations from generic u32 to the explicit little‑endian __le32 type, correcting assignments and casts that triggered sparse warnings about endianness mismatches.
The commit corrects a misspelled word in the SCSI subsystem documentation, updating the text to the proper spelling without altering any source code.
The patch updates the i.MX GPPLL fractional‑N clock driver to program the MFD register with 1 instead of 0, complying with the spec that disallows a zero value.

The patch adjusts kill_accessing_process() to return -EHWPOISON when a page is already poisoned, ensuring the kernel does not emit a spurious “Memory error not recovered” message and avoids sending duplicate SIGBUS signals after a race between CMCI and machine‑check handling.
The commit updates the device-tree binding documentation for the nvmem snvs-lpgpr driver, clarifying that i.MX8M compatible strings include a fallback to the older fsl,imx7d-snvs-lpgpr string.
The patch deletes an unnecessary dev_err call after devm_ioremap_resource, since that function already reports errors, preventing duplicate messages.

The commit adds handling for multicast router (mrouter) ports in the sparx5 network driver, ensuring they are included in all active multicast groups and that flooding is overridden, enabling proper multicast forwarding to those ports.
The patch renames the driver’s internal struct from xilinx_pcie_port to xilinx_pcie to follow the <driver>_pcie naming convention, updating all references accordingly, without altering functionality.
The patch removes a verbose debug printk from the Qualcomm QMP combo PHY init function, cleaning up unnecessary logging.
Updates the device‑tree binding files for GPIO‑controlled IR LEDs, converting the old description to the new DT schema format to align with kernel documentation standards.
The patch changes unx_lookup_cred() to allocate memory using the same mempool strategy as rpc_malloc(), aligning its allocation behavior with the rest of SUNRPC.
The commit updates the arm/qcom dt-bindings documentation to include the CRD and Lenovo Thinkpad X13s as valid compatible strings for the sc8280xp platform.
Adds a device‑tree node for the ethqos Ethernet controller on the SM8150 SoC, allowing the kernel to recognize and initialize the hardware.
The patch replaces the literal 9 with the PAGE_SECTORS_SHIFT macro in block code and removes an unnecessary cast, making the code clearer and relying on the compiler's implicit conversion.

Switches the DASD driver’s sysfs implementation to use kobj_type’s default_groups instead of the deprecated default_attrs, aligning with the newer kobject API and preparing for removal of the old field.

The patch updates the i915 DVO driver to replace a custom read‑modify‑write sequence with the generic intel_de_rmw() helper and switches to intel_de_posting_read() for posting reads, improving register access handling.
The commit removes the hisilicon,hi6220-reset device-tree binding because the related controllers are already documented elsewhere, cleaning up redundant binding files.
Reverts a prior commit that added pipe1 hardware support because it caused graphics hangs on Navi 21 with GNOME Wayland, restoring the previous state.

The patch introduces a small wrapper struct for the hisi PCI driver to store the __iomem pointer instead of a generic void *, eliminating a sparse static‑analysis warning about address‑space mismatched pointer conversion.
Extends the DRM/amdkfd PROCESS_INFO ioctl to report the number of SVM ranges and their private data size, enabling CRIU to discover these ranges for future checkpoint/restore support.
The patch introduces an explicit 'submission_initialized' flag in the i915 GuC driver, replacing the previous reliance on the LRC descriptor pool to determine if submission has been set up.
The commit corrects the calculation of relocation range limits for RISC‑V PC‑relative jumps using auipc+jalr, adjusting signed‑immediate handling so offsets near ±2^31 are accepted correctly.
The patch adds a check for the return value of clk_enable() in the davinci_mmc driver and returns an error if the call fails, improving error handling.
Adds missing asterisks to comment block delimiters in tracing/hist code, correcting comment syntax and eliminating clang warnings about malformed comment lines.
The patch enlarges the static name array used by the Exynos MCT driver so it can hold more timer identifiers, allowing correct printing of mct_tick values on CPUs with ≥12 local timers.

The patch adjusts KVM's handling of the decrementer timer during PowerPC HV migration so that the expiry value is computed relative to the guest timebase, eliminating a hang that occurred after migration.
The patch changes F2FS to keep io_flags in the bio structure so that I/O from different fio holders retains identical flags, allowing merges and avoiding unnecessary I/O splitting.
Simplifies compound_range_next() by dropping a redundant order check and using PageHead() instead of PageCompound(), based on the fact that compound pages always have order ≥1 and aren't tail pages.
The patch removes the HAL_DEF_IS_SUPPORT_ANT_DIV case from GetHalDefVar8188EUsb() in the r8188eu driver and places that logic in a new helper function, aiming to eliminate the legacy HAL layer.

The patch corrects the handling of DSC bits_per_pixel in the MSM DPU1 driver. It acknowledges that the register stores a 6.4 fixed‑point value, matching drm_dsc_config, and removes the previous incorrect integer‑only math that tried to extract fractional bits.
The commit updates the perf test suite by swapping the record test workload with the thloop program, eliminating the need for a compiler during testing.
Adds a check in hci_cmd_sync_queue to return an error when HCI_UNREGISTER is set, preventing command queuing after device unregistration and avoiding a use‑after‑free.
Adds a compiler hint (likely()) to ICE_XDP_REDIR in ice_run_xdp_zc and its caller, guiding the optimizer to treat XDP_REDIRECT as the common case, improving branch prediction and generated code.
The patch invalidates unresolved unicast neighbour entries for broadcast addresses when the broadcast route is added, forcing creation of a proper broadcast neighbour and stopping packet drops.
The patch deletes an unnecessary `asm/termios.h` header inclusion from `n_hdlc.c` because `linux/tty.h` already includes the required `linux/termios.h`, simplifying the include hierarchy.
The patch changes brcmstb_reset() to static, removing the -Wmissing-prototypes compiler warning in the sdhci‑brcmstb driver.
The commit deletes the guest PASID UAPI interfaces and related definitions from the IOMMU subsystem because they are unused and will be replaced by the new iommufd design, eliminating dead code.
Adds a return‑value check for mmc_add_host() in the moxart MMC driver and frees the allocated host on failure to avoid memory leak and kernel crash.
The patch replaces the 64‑bit modulo operator with the kernel helper div_u64_rem, removing the undefined __umoddi3 symbol that caused i386 compilation failures of the amdgpu driver.
The patch stops copying MACsec encryption keys when setting up a flow, eliminating the need to zero them later, thus reducing key handling.
The patch modifies vhost/vsock's transmit handling to allocate packet buffers with kvmalloc/kvfree instead of kmalloc, fixing allocation failures seen when large files are transferred over vsock.

The patch modifies the dp83822 Ethernet driver to stop enabling the receive‑error interrupt. Because the driver never reads/clears the RCSR register, error bits cause the register to fill and generate a flood of interrupts; disabling the interrupt eliminates the problem.
Adds a new compatible string for the Aries Embedded M100PFSEVP SOM/EVK in the RISC‑V dt‑bindings, documenting support for this hardware platform.
Adds runtime DSP path creation and freeing to the Intel AVS ASoC driver, tying it to PCM hw_params and hw_free callbacks, using topology templates to allocate resources dynamically.
The patch adds a mandatory TLB flush after updating page table entries for VG20 GPUs with XGMI bridges, fixing stalls caused by stale cached PTEs in the translation cache.

Adds support for Allwinner H616 USB PHY by defining a new configuration struct with its specific quirks and registering a new compatible name, enabling the driver to recognize and handle this PHY variant.
Adds support for IVO M133NW4J-R3 eDP panel by creating a new panel entry in drm/panel-edp, using existing timing preset due to missing documentation.
Renames the KVM self‑test binary from evmcs_test to hyperv_evmcs to match Hyper‑V naming conventions, removing the redundant _test suffix.
The patch adds the static qualifier to the Arizona MFD driver’s I2C and SPI of_match tables, correcting their linkage after the tables were split.

Adds infrastructure for KPP template instances: defines kpp_instance struct, registration function, helper conversions, and documentation, enabling future template-based key‑pair primitives like RFC 7919 groups.
The patch reorders the IRQ handler registration for the imx‑rngc driver to occur after the interrupt mask is cleared, preventing a premature completion that caused a kernel crash during boot.

The commit removes unnecessary supply and clock description entries from the Qualcomm QMP PHY device‑tree binding files, cleaning up documentation that duplicates information inferable from resource names.
Updates dt‑bindings for AD7923/AD7924 ADCs, adding notes that AD7927 works with the AD7928 driver and documenting that AD7923 and AD7924 share the same driver handling.
The commit raises the maximum LED brightness for the Dream Cheeky HID device to 63 by updating a driver constant, based on empirical testing.
The patch adds handling for invalid size reads in mvebu_pcie_hw_rd_conf(): it returns all‑ones and PCIBIOS_BAD_REGISTER_NUMBER, mirroring the write path, thus correcting erroneous behavior.
The patch removes the custom bit_reverse() implementation in the packing library and replaces its uses with the kernel-provided bitrev8() macro plus a bit‑shift, eliminating duplicated code.

The patch moves the call to local_flush_tlb_all() to run right after pt‑walker setup and before any page allocations, and relocates output_pgtable_bits_defines() into tlb_init(). This ensures stale TLB entries are cleared early, fixing SMP boot failure after kexec/kdump.

The patch adds a cache for the result of extent‑sharedness checks while walking the inode subvolume B‑tree during fiemap, avoiding repeated tree and delayed‑ref lookups for consecutive extents, yielding 2‑3× speedup.
Updates perf c2c documentation to describe the newly added 'N/A' metric for store operations in the report table.

The patch relocates the definitions of mach_get_rtc_pll, mach_set_rtc_pll and mach_hwclk into the same source tree used by time.c for the m68k nommu configuration, eliminating undefined reference errors during linking when CONFIG_RTC_DRV_GENERIC is enabled.
The patch adds code to release enclosure device objects when the mpi3mr driver is unloaded and before rescanning devices on controller reset, ensuring proper cleanup of allocated resources.

The patch fixes race conditions and double‑free bugs in hugetlb vma lock handling, ensures a lock is allocated for each VM_MAYSHARE vma during split, updates unmap logic to free the lock instead of clearing VM_MAYSHARE, and adjusts sharing checks.
Patch enables a process created with vfork+exec to switch to a different time namespace after exec, handling the vvar page issue without adding a new clone flag.
The patch removes the per‑CPU conntrack dying list, replaces it with a per‑net list, and adjusts when the IPS_CONFIRMED flag is set to avoid double unlinking during destruction.
Removes a duplicated 'is' word from a comment in the ab8500_fg power supply driver, fixing a typo.
The patch adds a helper i2c_parse_fw_timings() to the DesignWare I2C driver, enabling it to read I2C timing parameters supplied by firmware, similar to existing PCI driver support.
The patch adds the X86_FEATURE_XENPV flag to the list of CPU features that are specially handled when disabled, updating disabled-features.h accordingly.
The patch reverts changes that broke the return‑thunk mechanism on x86, adds a CPU feature flag X86_FEATURE_RETHUNK, and simplifies padding to INT3 only.
The commit updates the dt-binding documentation for the Realtek rt5682s codec, adding entries for the AVDD and MICVDD power supplies.
The patch eliminates unnecessary resetting of arch‑specific control arrays in set_mba_sc() and moves mbps_val[] reset to reset_all_ctrls(), simplifying the resctrl code.
The patch renames the struct vkms_composer to vkms_frame_info for clearer semantics and also corrects an iosys_map_is_null check in compose_plane, addressing a potential bug.
The patch changes fbcon sysfs attribute show functions to use sysfs_emit instead of snprintf/scnprintf, aligning with the recommended API for emitting strings to sysfs.
The patch removes assignments to udc->dev.driver in the USB gadget core, keeping the driver pointer NULL and eliminating the race that caused a use‑after‑free in dev_uevent reported by syzbot.
Adds a missing iounmap() call in zorro7xx_remove_one() to release the I/O memory region allocated during probe, fixing a resource leak.
Renames the jz4740-i2s driver’s set_fmt_new function back to set_fmt after the ASoC core switched to the new direct clock API, restoring the standard callback name.

The patch reorganizes the OnDisassoc handler in the r8188eu driver, extracting the logic for the non‑access‑point case from a large conditional block and placing it earlier, simplifying the function flow.

The patch adds a new helper intel_async_flip_check_uapi() that runs early in the atomic validation path to verify whether a plane can perform async flips, and adds early checks for CRTC activity, modeset flag, and plane enable state, moving the async‑flip capability test earlier in i915.
The patch removes kernel-doc annotations from static functions in drm/edid and replaces them with plain comments, preserving the explanatory text while simplifying documentation.

The patch updates the spear-keyboard driver to replace the deprecated SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS() macro with DEFINE_SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS() and pm_sleep_ptr(), removing __maybe_unused annotations to silence unused‑function warnings while preserving dead‑code removal.
Adds logic in RDMA core to compute UDP source port from GRH flow label or, if absent, from local/remote QP numbers, and sets the port before packet transmission.
Adds support for the on‑board RT711 SDCA audio codec on Intel Meteor Lake (MTL) reference platform, integrating it into the ASoC Intel SOF driver.

The patch changes the MCR wait‑for‑register firmware helper to acquire and release uncore->lock internally, fixing a race where the caller previously omitted the lock and caused lockdep assertions, and avoids holding the lock for the whole wait.
Adds a new ACPI device ID for the AMD PMC controller, enabling the kernel to recognize and bind the newer controller version.
The patch changes the r8188eu driver to call ieee80211_get_DA from the core wireless stack instead of its own get_da helper, aligning the driver with the generic API.
Adds a new compatible string for the Elan eth3915n touchscreen controller in the input touchscreen dt‑bindings, enabling the kernel to match this chip as compatible with ekth3500.
The patch updates the sfc driver to replace scnprintf calls with sysfs_emit (or sysfs_emit_at) in sysfs show functions, following the sysfs documentation.
Adds support for Intel LBR format V7 in perf, introduces shared capability flags in x86_pmu, a new init function, and simplifies capability checks.
Merges struct led_priv and struct LED_871x in the r8188eu driver, moving LED_871x fields into led_priv and updating code to use the unified struct.

The patch adjusts the NFP driver’s read of the 32‑bit extended capability so it no longer assumes qword alignment, using a safe access method to avoid unaligned‑access exceptions on certain architectures.

The patch adds validation in nf_tables set handling: when a set specifies field_count, the NFT_SET_CONCAT flag must be set; if the flag is present without field_count, the code returns EINVAL, ensuring consistency.
Creates the Linux 6.2 release‑candidate tag, merging previous changes and updating the version identifier; no substantive code changes are introduced.
The patch reverts a prior change that blocked APIC writes for non‑ICR registers, allowing x2APIC MSR writes needed for x2AVIC, thus correcting a regression.

The patch corrects the TLV length validation in tipc_nl_compat_name_table_dump_header, adding proper casting so that a negative length from TLV_GET_DATA_LEN() is handled, eliminating the KMSAN uninitialized‑value bug reported by syzbot.
Adds a compatible string for the Altera SoCFPGA Stratix 10 Development Kit in the arm64 device tree, enabling the kernel to recognize the board.
Adds two regulator supply properties to the HDMI node of the rk3399-roc-pc device tree to match hardware and silence kernel warnings.
Renames the KUnit test configuration entry for the IIO format test to match the required CONFIG_<name>_KUNIT_TEST naming pattern.

The patch updates the KVM arm64 self‑test to disable single‑step using the proper KVM_GUESTDBG_ENABLE flag instead of the test‑only SINGLE_STEP_DISABLE enum, which previously had the same numeric value but was semantically incorrect.
The commit updates the Qualcomm GSBI device‑tree binding documentation, converting it to the new DT schema format.
The patch splits sd_read_protection() into two functions, moves integrity probing to the end of discovery, removes a redundant revalidate call, and makes log output less verbose.

Adds audio support for the Renesas RZ/G2UL SMARC evaluation board by updating the device tree: inserts SSI1 pinctrl entries into the soc-pinctrl dtsi and adds SSI1 and CPU sound_dai nodes to the board dtsi, enabling the audio subsystem.

The patch removes the driver‑enforced edge‑rising interrupt trigger for ath10k SNOC, allowing the Device Tree to specify the correct type (e.g., level‑high) and fixing IRQ mapping failures on Qualcomm WCN3990 platforms.
Reverts an erroneous __user attribute on the buffer argument of proc_dointvec_minmax_sysadmin() after its relocation, restoring the correct type to silence sparse warnings.
Adds a GPIO IRQ handler and implements irq_chip helper functions (irq_set_type, irq_mask, irq_unmask, irq_ack) for the Microchip pci1xxxx driver, enabling proper interrupt configuration and handling.
Deletes the unused 'work' member from struct mlx5e_async_ctx in the mlx5e driver, simplifying the data structure.
The patch modifies rxrpc congestion control to stop persisting a zero cwnd across calls, resetting to the initial cwnd after idle periods and preserving ssthresh, thus preventing transmission stalls.

The patch relocates several root helper functions from accessors.h back to ctree.h, restoring their proper placement alongside btrfs_root definitions to simplify synchronization of accessor files with btrfs-progs.
Adds support for the SMUIO hardware block introduced in AMD GPU firmware 13.0.9 by implementing a software function in the amdgpu discovery code to recognize and handle this new block.
The patch raises the maximum DRAM bandwidth percentage for the DCN315 display engine from its previous value to 60% so that DML validation succeeds when multiple HDR monitors are attached.

The patch changes the mpt3sas driver to compute the 4 GB DMA boundary using the pool’s DMA address rather than the virtual address, correcting an incorrect limit check that could cause DMA beyond the hardware limit.
Adds a GPIO property to the wcd938x device tree bindings to allow selection between CTIA and OMTP headset configurations.
The patch adds a call to mlx5e_fs_vlan_free(fs) before kvfree(fs) in mlx5e_fs_init(), eliminating a use‑after‑free condition in the mlx5e driver.

The patch adjusts the ath11k driver for QCA6390/WCN6855 so that when a station disconnects, only the WMI_PEER_DELETE_CMDID is skipped, ensuring peer->sta is cleared and preventing a use‑after‑free introduced by a prior change.
The commit deletes the function rxrpc_get_reply_time() because it is no longer referenced; the code now uses the call issue time instead of the reply time.
The commit changes the maintainer e‑mail address in the dt‑bindings documentation to Luca Ceresoli's preferred Bootlin address, modifying only a text line.
The patch modifies the musb mpfs driver probe() so that error paths return proper negative errno values instead of zero, fixing incorrect success returns.

Moves netdev_notifier registration from each device probe to module initialization, avoiding duplicate registrations when multiple ADIN1110/2111 devices are present, thus eliminating probe warnings/failures.

The patch drops the JFS filesystem’s ->writepage callback, which was inefficient and only used as a fallback, and instead assigns the generic ->migrate_folio helper, eliminating the old implementation.
Adds support for a new queue allocation command in iwlwifi, refactors the allocation API to use a station mask and new flags, and requires explicit queue removal before station removal.

Adds a helper function virt_get_pte_hva() for aarch64 KVM selftests to retrieve the host virtual address of a page table entry for a given guest virtual address, enabling future tests to manipulate access flags.
The commit removes obsolete perfbuf functions from libbpf and simplifies the related option structures, updating the API to a cleaner state.
The patch adds a USB audio quirk for the Fiero SC-01 device when running firmware v1.0.0, reusing the quirks from firmware v1.1.0 to handle hard‑coded sample rates, thus enabling proper operation.
Stops running task work at the start of io_uring_enter, deferring it until after submissions to allow better batching; adjusts handling for SQPOLL, IOPOLL, and cqring wait.

The commit reorganizes omap3 clock nodes in the device tree, grouping CM_ICLKEN_WKUP clocks under the TI clksel binding and adds clock-output-names to eliminate unique_unit_address and node_name_chars_strict warnings.
The patch corrects a spelling mistake in a comment within the OCFS2 filesystem source, without modifying any executable code.
The patch rewrites try_to_free_swap to accept a folio instead of a page, removing extra compound_head calls and shrinking kernel text by ~74 bytes.
Changes cfg80211_auth_request.key_idx from unsigned to signed to allow -1 sentinel when key is NULL, removing static‑checker warnings.
The patch adds a 'reset' argument to the mtk_wed_tx_ring_setup function, updating its signature and related calls to enable future Wireless Ethernet Dispatcher reset handling.
Adds capability checks to NVMe management ioctls (reset, rescan, etc.) so only admin users can invoke them, aligning them with existing passthrough restrictions.
The patch modifies the AMD KFD DRM driver to store and restore the same SDMA queue ID during CRIU checkpoint/restore, ensuring queues are recreated with their original identifiers.
The patch removes the HW_VAR_AC_PARAM_VI handling from SetHwReg8188EU() in the r8188eu driver and replaces it with a direct rtw_write32() call, simplifying the register write logic.
The patch replaces snprintf calls in drivers/bus/mhi/host/init.c with sysfs_emit/sysfs_emit_at to satisfy a Coccinelle warning about using snprintf in sysfs code.
Updates OMAP3 device‑tree to group CONTROL_DEVCONF0 clocks via TI clksel binding and adds clock-output-names, removing unique_unit_address and node_name_chars_strict warnings under strict make flags.
Adds a pinctrl/GPIO driver for Intel Meteor Lake, implementing support for the next‑generation GPIO hardware while keeping compatibility with existing Intel core pinctrl driver.

The commit extracts the QCS404 remote processor Peripheral Authentication Service device‑tree bindings into a dedicated file, separating them from other remoteproc bindings to simplify the tree and aid maintenance.
Adds a clock name entry for the bi‑tcxo clock to the Qualcomm SDM845 camera‑CC device‑tree binding, updating the schema so the driver can recognize the clock passed via DT.
Changes the dsa_switch struct field num_ports from size_t (8 bytes) to unsigned int (4 bytes) to eliminate padding and shrink the overall struct size, improving memory usage.
The patch removes unnecessary chip‑type comment lines from the ftdi_sio USB‑serial driver, cleaning up the source without altering functionality.
The commit updates rxe_av.c to replace calls to the generic pr_xxx() debug helpers with the rxe_dbg_xxx() macros, aligning logging with the RXE driver's naming convention.
The patch removes the amdgpu_ras_need_send_ras_feature helper and directly checks if the block is GFX before sending the RAS feature, limiting the operation to the graphics IP block.
The commit edits the MAINTAINERS file to remove Jukka Rissanen from the list of 6lowpan maintainers because he no longer works on the subsystem.
The patch initializes the previously uninitialized variable 'next' in find_first_clear_extent_bit, removing a compile‑time error caused by the compiler detecting use of an uninitialized variable.
Adds bookkeeping in the i915 buddy allocator to record total and per‑resource visible memory, updates debug output and reserves accounting, with code tweaks to avoid unnecessary scans.
Adds a common mechanism for CXL.mem endpoint drivers to enumerate ancestor CXL switch ports and validate CXL.mem links, handling race conditions via parent port locks and reference tracking.

The commit deletes the now‑unused function fscrypt_set_test_dummy_encryption() after its callers were switched to fscrypt_parse_test_dummy_encryption() and fscrypt_add_test_dummy_key(), cleaning up dead code in the fscrypt subsystem.

The patch updates the hisi_acc VFIO driver to use new device‑life‑cycle helper functions, moves migration‑specific initialization from the probe routine to a dedicated init callback, and deletes the now‑unused vfio_pci_core_{un}init_device() functions.
Refactors btrfs's submit_stripe_bio by removing orig_bio and clone parameters, deriving them internally, and moving cloning decision inside the function.

The patch modifies the Renesas r8a77470 pinctrl driver to replace explicit reserved register field definitions with shorthand negative-width fields and merges adjacent reserved fields, reducing driver size by about 114 bytes.

The patch reorders the if/else chain that selects frequency tables based on GRAPHICS_VER, placing the highest version check (>=11) first to follow the driver’s “last version first” convention and simplify future platform extensions.
Updates the duplicated struct vmcb_control_area in KVM nSVM selftests to include newly introduced fields, allowing the selftests to exercise the new virtualization features.

The patch removes the buddy-page prefetch in free_pcppages_bulk(), arguing that the extra calculations and prefetch cost outweigh any possible stall reduction when the zone lock is held, thus simplifying the bulk free path.
Adds a powerpc PMU self‑test that enables branch‑stack sampling and verifies it does not crash, exercising the earlier crash‑fix path.
Adds error handling to ftpm_mod_init(): checks driver_register() return value and unregisters ftpm_tee_plat_driver on failure before returning the error.
The patch updates the max310x serial driver to populate the rs485_supported field, documenting which serial_rs485 features the hardware can handle.
The patch restructures the HOP helper functions in the MMU V1 driver to use the newly defined shift/mask arrays, simplifying the code and aligning it with the updated data representation.

The patch lowers the log level of devm_thermal_of_zone_register() failures from error to debug in the Qualcomm thermal driver, because -ENODEV is expected when a DT node is missing, preventing unnecessary error messages.
The patch updates the USB control‑message timeout used when reading EDID in the udl DRM driver to the standard 5‑second USB timeout constant, making it consistent with other drivers.

The patch updates the amdgpu DRM driver to avoid programming gfxhub_v3_0_3 system aperture registers when running in SR‑IOV virtual functions, because those registers are no longer in the RLCG access range and will be set by the host.
The patch deletes the vgpu->released member and its sanity‑check in the i915 GVT driver, delegating vGPU lifecycle handling to the VFIO core and cleaning up dead code.
The patch deletes the arch_has_empty_bitmaps flag from the x86 resctrl code, using min_cbm_bits to decide if zero CBM is supported, thereby simplifying the architecture data structure.
Adds a helper function for querying RAS poison mode, renames the existing function, and notes that SRIOV guests don’t need to query it, simplifying the amdgpu driver code.
The patch changes the type of ata_port::fastdrain_cnt from unsigned long to unsigned int because it is only ever assigned from 32‑bit unsigned int values, simplifying the struct definition.
The commit changes the is_partially_uptodate helper to accept a folio argument and updates its signature to use byte counts, aligning it with the per‑folio uptodate flag and improving type clarity.
The commit reorders the entries of CONFIG_SURFACE_PLATFORMS in RISC‑V defconfig files to match the order produced by savedefconfig, without altering functionality.
The patch corrects the selection of the microengine (ME) field in the map_queue packet for GFX11 AMDGPU drivers, ensuring the appropriate ME is used for graphics, compute, or scheduling queues.

The patch changes the tracing subsystem so that traceon/traceoff triggers respect the specific tracing instance they are attached to, rather than affecting the global tracing state, correcting confusing behavior for users.
Introduces helper function mcp251xfd_is_fd_mode() and updates driver code to call it instead of inline checks, improving readability and maintainability of CAN-FD mode detection.
The patch deletes the mount/umount sequence for /sys and /sys/fs/bpf in the BPF self‑tests' open/close_netns helpers, simplifying the test code and removing unnecessary, error‑prone steps.

The patch updates the ssd130x DRM driver to replace direct accesses to drm_plane.state with the drm_atomic_get_new_plane_state() helper, aligning with the atomic API and avoiding direct struct manipulation.

The patch changes the vcpu field sysregs_loaded_on_cpu from a simple boolean to a more expressive state flag in the KVM arm64 code, reflecting whether system registers are loaded on the physical CPU, improving internal state tracking.
Adds a forward declaration of struct folio in cacheflush.h to eliminate compilation warnings for code that includes the header.
The patch updates the mt7921 driver to stop dropping received frames that use VHT MCS indices 10‑11, which the hardware can handle, allowing those frames to be processed correctly.

The commit updates the arm64 socfpga device tree, adding the altr,sysmgr-syscon binding and a clk-phase-sd-hs property to the SDMMC node so the driver can configure the CIU clock phase via the system manager.
The patch adds a free() call for the structure holding parsed command‑line arguments in the rtla/osnoise tool, ensuring the allocated memory is released before the program exits.
The commit adjusts SubVP handling for Dynamic Refresh Rate (DRR) cases: avoids VSYNC lock, uses firmware for manual trigger on DCN32/321, and adds a command bit to flag DRR usage.

The patch renames the reference‑counting helpers in the rxe RDMA driver: rxe_add_ref() → rxe_get() and rxe_drop_ref() → rxe_put(), updating all call sites. It is a cosmetic change to use conventional naming and improve readability.

Adds a swap_free() call in try_to_unmap() to undo a prior swap_duplicate() when arch_unmap_one() fails, completing cleanup of anonymous page unmapping and fixing memory corruption in the COW/rmap path.
Adds a cs_dsp library and ALSA control interface for the CS35L41 DSP, exposing DSP controls via ALSA and fixing the Kconfig dependency.
Version bump to Linux 5.19-rc6, likely a tag aggregating many changes, but specific modifications are not visible.
The patch updates KVM x86 MMU code to set iter->old_spte to the value returned by a failed cmpxchg, removing a separate SPTE read and consolidating logic.
The patch adds logic to the hisi I2C driver to retrieve the bus clock frequency using either a dedicated clock node or the legacy clk_rate property, falling back as needed.
The patch adds a printk in the UV platform code to display the gap hole end size, which reflects the number of physical address bits used by the system.
Adds initialization of vqs_list_lock in vdev_info_init() so virtio_test no longer hangs in __vring_new_virtqueue(), fixing the missing lock setup.

Implements a new hot‑page identification method for memory‑tiering NUMA balancing by recording scan time, measuring hint‑page‑fault latency, reusing struct page bits, adding a hot‑threshold and debugfs control, and includes a bug‑fix for disabling tiering.
The commit adds a Chinese translation of the devicetree changesets documentation (docs/zh_CN/devicetree/changesets.rst), updating the documentation tree with localized content.
The patch changes the cast in the arm64 LSE atomic implementation to a size‑matched pointer type, removing a -Warray-bounds warning while leaving the generated binary unchanged.

The commit relocates the extract‑cert script from the generic scripts directory into the certs directory, updates the Makefile to reference the new location, and configures it to be built only when needed.

The patch modifies the stmmac Ethernet driver to allow changing the MTU while the interface is up by releasing and reopening the driver and invoking set_filter, eliminating the EBUSY error that occurred during DSA‑initiated MTU changes.
Moves the static pmu_ops structure into the init‑only ops table and marks it __initdata, reducing memory footprint and preventing runtime modifications after initialization.
The commit removes an outdated reference to max77693.txt from the MAINTAINERS file after the driver documentation was migrated to a YAML file, correcting a merge‑induced mistake.
Updates the Qualcomm SM8350 pinctrl device‑tree binding to stop marking the 'function' property as required for pins that are not GPIOs, fixing an incorrect validation rule.
Adds a BPF self‑test that reproduces a warning triggered by a decl_tag in a function prototype return type, exercising btf_type_id_size.
The patch updates the RTC self‑test to check for the presence of an RTC device and skip the test when none is found, avoiding unnecessary failures.

The patch updates fbtft_init_display() to correctly handle s16‑type init‑sequence values when printing debug information, replacing the previous print with fbtft_par_dbg_hex(). This ensures proper hex representation of signed 16‑bit data.
Adds a guard in hv_netvsc to delay VF registration until the host sends the VF association message, eliminating a race that broke the VF path during VM boot.
Adds mm reference handling in SVM deferred list work to keep the mm struct alive while the work processes ranges, preventing premature release and leaks.
Adds optional prepare_streaming and unprepare_streaming queue ops to vb2, allowing resource claim/validation at VIDIOC_STREAMON and release at STREAMOFF or file close.
The patch ensures that any existing firmware session is explicitly torn down before a remote N2N login is retried when the authentication application starts, preventing repeated login attempts.
The patch adds reference‑count handling to the raw‑MIDI output buffer during snd_rawmidi_drain_output and checks the count on close, preventing concurrent buffer resize while draining.
The commit moves several exported extent_io_tree helper functions into extent-io-tree.c, consolidating helpers that don't rely on tree_search() and shrinking the core file.
The commit introduces a new __vcpu_run() helper in the KVM self‑tests, allowing tests to invoke KVM_RUN without directly handling ioctl asserts.
Adds mt7915_mcu_rdd_background_enable and mt7915_mcu_background_chain_ctrl routines to configure a dedicated DFS receive chain, enabling zero‑wait DFS (CAC) on rdd2.
Adds a device‑tree entry for RK3399 VOPs defining the gamma LUT memory region (base+0x2000) to enable gamma control.

The patch disables the KVM_HC_CLOCK_PAIRING hypercall when a vCPU has tsc_always_catchup set, because the hypercall causes an infinite loop in pvclock_read_retry; it changes the return code to KVM_EFAULT and removes a warning.
Adds a kernel-doc comment describing the @server parameter of smb311_update_preauth_hash() to silence a warning from the kernel-doc script.
The commit adds new Qualcomm QDU1000 and QRU1000 SoC identifiers to the arm/qcom,ids device‑tree binding header, enabling these platforms to be referenced in DT files.
The patch updates the ipaq-micro driver to check platform_get_irq() return value correctly, replacing a null check with a <0 test because the function returns a negative error code on failure.

The patch updates rcutorture to use kthread_run_on_cpu() instead of separate kthread_create_on_node, kthread_bind and wake_up_process calls, reducing boilerplate and simplifying thread creation on a specific CPU.

The patch restructures the lpfc driver’s handling of RSCN/SCR/RDF/EDC/FARPR for SLI‑3 and SLI‑4, replacing direct SLI‑3 iocb field accesses with new generic get/set helpers and separating SLI‑3/SLI‑4 specific code paths.

The patch separates VBT data into global and per‑panel sections, moves panel‑specific parsing to the output probing phase, stores it in connector->panel.vbt, and removes a micro‑optimization check in intel_drrs_frontbuffer_update().
The patch deletes an unnecessary assignment to the variable 'bytes' in the echoaudio MIDI driver because the value is overwritten later and never read, eliminating a clang dead‑store warning.

The commit introduces a platform‑specific data structure for Intel Agilex DWC2 USB controller, indicating that its hardware does not support clock‑gating, so the driver can disable that feature on this platform.

The patch removes the _bh annotation from all spinlocks in the rxrpc subsystem because RCU callbacks no longer acquire spinlocks and packet handling now runs in an I/O thread rather than soft‑irq context.
Updates the TI DAC5571 IIO driver to use i2c's .probe_new() callback, which lacks the i2c_device_id argument, and adds explicit device‑id handling inside the probe function.

The commit removes unused conditionals and configuration options from the Qualcomm QMP UFS PHY driver, simplifying the code and eliminating dead paths that are not required by any supported UFS PHY devices.
Adds a reset of the GCC_SDCC_BCR register during SDHC‑MSM controller initialization to clear previous power states and avoid software reset timeout failures.

Updates the RISC‑V Canaan device‑tree for the K210 SoC by splitting the combined timer node into two separate nodes with correct interrupt arrays, eliminating dtbs_check warnings about non‑standard interrupt configuration.
Adds a new compatible string for Qualcomm MSM8974 CCI in the I2C dt-bindings, documenting support for two I2C masters.
The patch updates the arm64 resume path to load vabits_actual, matching the new __cpu_setup() behavior, so the correct VA bit width is used on 52‑bit enabled builds, fixing boot failures.
The patch adds error handling to ssi_init(): if platform_driver_register() fails, it now unregisters ssi_pdriver to clean up.
The patch updates the block layer's bio_copy_data_iter to correctly handle destination bio_vec offsets, restoring functionality needed when bcache copies into bios with non‑zero offsets.
Adds optional reset‑GPIO handling to the onboard USB hub driver, releasing the reset line after power‑up and asserting it again before power‑down, exposing a new configurable reset control.
The patch removes unused OF header includes (of_irq.h, of_platform.h) from the 8250_dw serial driver and adds the missing mod_devicetable.h, updating the driver’s include list.
The patch changes a left‑shift of a signed 32‑bit constant in __mdiobus_register to use an unsigned type, eliminating undefined behavior flagged by UBSAN.
The patch adds const qualifiers to pointers of struct detailed_timing used in DRM EDID parsing callbacks, making the data read‑only within those functions.

The patch updates the xHCI driver to stop enabling U1/U2 link power management for USB3 devices behind tier‑2+ hubs when Intel’s tier policy disallows LPM, adding an early policy check to avoid unnecessary MEL commands.
The patch deletes a redundant return variable in rtw_wx_get_essid of the r8188eu driver, which was initialized to zero but never assigned, simplifying the code.
Adds a check in ext4 to skip launching the ext4lazyinit thread on read‑only mounts, since block allocation isn’t needed, avoiding unnecessary work.
The commit updates STM32 device‑tree source files, renaming pinctrl nodes to the standard 'pinctrl' name to silence warnings introduced by a recent pinctrl.yaml addition.
The commit removes Naveen Krishna Chatradhi from the maintainers list of the dt-bindings/hwmon/ntc-thermistor entry because his email bounces.

The commit updates the kernel-doc script to replace its custom usage/error handling with the standard Pod::Usage module, integrating documentation printing and simplifying argument parsing error handling.
Adds ability for the TPS68470 clock driver to accept multiple consumers via platform data, allowing several sensors on x86 platforms to share the same clock.
Adds a CAN/ldisc driver named can327 that lets ELM327 OBD‑II adapters function as inexpensive CAN interfaces, with accompanying documentation.
Adds a missing space in the ext4 blockmap table heading to realign cells, eliminating the malformed table warning and allowing the documentation to load correctly.

The commit updates the thermal driver for MMIO to use the newer device‑tree (OF) registration API, converting its operations to the generic thermal_zone_device_ops structure and registering the zone with the new helper, simplifying initialization.
Updates Mediatek mutex driver to use the newly added DDP_COMPONENT_DITHER0 enum index for MT8365, aligning all mutex mod arrays with the revised enum for consistency; no functional behavior changes.

The patch changes blk-crypto's sysfs registration/unregistration functions to receive a gendisk pointer, using the already available gendisk when these functions are called, in preparation for upcoming block layer sysfs handling changes.

The patch removes an incorrect spinlock (css_set_lock) around kernfs_walk_and_get, which may sleep, and adds a special helper for the default cgroup hierarchy to safely reference the root cgroup without holding the lock.

The commit updates the Rockchip arm64 device tree for NanoPi4, adding the enable-strobe-pulldown property to the eMMC PHY to re‑enable the internal pull‑down on the strobe line, fixing HS400 mode I/O errors.
Adds DSD audio bit format support (DSD_U8, DSD_U16_LE, DSD_U32_LE) to the Freescale SAI ASoC driver, extending its format handling.

The patch adds missing cleanup calls in the probe and resource‑setup error paths of the sun8i_a83t MIPI CSI‑2 driver, mirroring the remove function, to correctly free allocated resources when initialization fails.
The patch renames macros in the gpio‑f7188x driver by adding a common prefix, cleaning up the GPIO namespace; no functional changes, only naming/style adjustments.

The patch changes the random driver so that reads from /dev/urandom attempt a best‑effort entropy generation; if it succeeds the RNG is marked initialized, making the device safe without requiring a guaranteed entropy call.
Reorders RTC‑CMOS driver init so cmos_wake_setup() runs after cmos_do_probe() sets driver data, eliminating a NULL‑pointer dereference in rtc_handler() on boot.
The commit corrects a typo in the IOAT DMA engine module description, changing "idel" to "idle", without altering any functional code.
The patch updates many kernel comments in mm/vmscan, replacing references to pages with folios after the folio conversion, without altering code behavior.
The commit updates the AD5380 IIO DAC driver to use the i2c core’s .probe_new() callback, which lacks the i2c_device_id argument, and adds explicit device‑id lookup inside the probe function.
Renames iscsi_conn_queue_work() to iscsi_conn_queue_xmit() in the iSCSI driver to better describe its role of queuing only transmit operations.
The patch replaces atomic_long_cmpxchg with atomic_long_try_cmpxchg in __io_account_mem, removing an extra compare and simplifying code, with no functional behavior change.
The patch removes now‑redundant validation checks in the IOMMU .release_device path and stops freeing fwspec structures that the core now handles, simplifying the release flow.
Corrects a misspelled word 'postion' to 'position' in the IB/qib driver, affecting only comments or identifiers without changing behavior.
Adds the #reset-cells property to the Mediatek MT8192/MT8195 device‑tree bindings, setting its value to 1 and linking to existing infra_ao reset definitions.
Adds support for Intel 5 Series/3400 PCI device ID 0x3b57, handling it like 0x3b56, enabling HDMI/DP audio via i915 and fixing issue 2751 where audio was non‑functional.

The patch updates the clocksource-switch self‑test to correctly propagate child process errors by interpreting system()'s waitpid‑style return with appropriate macros, instead of returning it directly which always yielded zero.
The patch expands the ethtool ring‑parameter interface to include get/set operations for the driver’s tx_push setting, allowing userspace to control the fast‑path descriptor push via ethtool -G/g.
The patch removes an unnecessary 'return' statement from a void function in the ALSA hda/via driver, cleaning up the code.
The patch changes rcuscale's Kconfig so it can be built without RCU Tasks (e.g., on CONFIG_PREEMPT_NONE kernels), removing an unnecessary dependency, reducing kernel size and simplifying tracing.
Adds checks of rxe_get() return values in RDMA/rxe tasklets to detect when a queue‑pair reference count has dropped to zero, preventing use of an invalid qp after the reference is released.
Adds a teardown helper that frees tagger-owned storage when a DSA switch driver is unbound, ensuring proper cleanup and avoiding use-after-free.

The patch extends io_uring's completion queue handling by adding storage for two 64‑bit return values needed by the CQE32 format, reusing the existing hash‑list node structure to hold this extra data.
The commit modifies the XDP redirect self‑test to create a temporary network namespace instead of using a fixed name, avoiding name collisions when the namespace already exists.
The commit moves the module_list size computation inside the modules loop in the ASoC qdsp6 audioreach driver, removing a separate calculation and simplifying the code.

Adds a check that existing DSA master devices cannot be attached as upper interfaces of other device types, except when the switch uses no DSA tags, ensuring LAG interfaces of DSA masters stay DSA masters and preventing later addition of unsupported upper ports.
Adds qca8k_bulk_read/write helpers that use the management Ethernet path for bulk packet I/O, updates FDB handling to use them and reduces the register count for FDB reads from four to three.

The commit adds logic to query and probe active Subfunctions (SFs) during the mlx5 driver probe, fixing a situation where SF devices on different functions were not recreated after the parent driver reloads.

The patch replaces separate calls to dma_set_mask() and dma_set_coherent_mask() with the combined dma_set_mask_and_coherent(), removes dead code, and folds qed_set_coherency_mask() into its caller, simplifying the qed driver’s DMA mask handling.
The patch adds a kernel configuration option that enables building of the AMD RPL Platform ACP audio drivers, allowing the drivers to be compiled when the option is selected.
The commit updates the arm64 lib strcmp implementation by importing the latest upstream Arm Optimized Routines version, which adds Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) support.
The commit modifies the lpfc driver to derive VMID registration from fabric‑provided FLOGI_ACC parameters instead of static module parameters, ensuring compatibility across different switch brands.
The commit adds a RAS poison creation handler to the amdgpu DRM driver and separates the UMC handler, preparing for a future poison consumption handler.
The commit updates the maintainer entry in the dt-bindings clock YAML file for rockchip,rk3395-cru.yaml, replacing an outdated maintainer with the current Rockchip clock maintainer as requested.

The patch stops ext4 from incrementing the i_version counter on EA inodes, because those inodes repurpose i_version for reference‑count storage; it adds a check in ext4_mark_iloc_dirty() to skip inode_inc_iversion() when EXT4_EA_INODE_FL is set, fixing the xfstest ext4/026 failure.
The commit changes the default PSCI version reported to KVM guests on arm64 from the previous value to 1.1, updating a constant/default configuration without altering functionality.

The patch replaces all strlcpy calls with strscpy in the misc subsystem where the return value was ignored, using a coccinelle script. Both functions behave the same for this usage, so the change is purely API substitution.

The commit updates Qualcomm MSM8960 pin controller device‑tree binding files to the new DT schema, renaming child nodes with '-state' and '-pins' suffixes to match other Qualcomm schemas and ensure consistent parsing.
Adds cleanup to free mount options on ntfs_fill_super() error path, eliminating a memory leak reported by syzbot.
The patch eliminates a duplicate call that sends the EnableGfxImu message, ensuring the message is only sent once from set_gfx_power_up_by_imu.
Adds a macro in mm/damon/modules-common to generate identical module parameters for DAMON_RECLAIM and DAMON_LRU_SORT, reducing duplication and easing future reuse.
The patch adjusts the CC_HAS_ASM_GOTO_TIED_OUTPUT Kconfig test to work when /bin/sh is dash by removing a newline that caused syntax errors, ensuring the test detects the compiler feature correctly.
The commit deletes the mt8195-specific MOD0 and SOF0 macro definitions and makes the mt8195 platform use the existing mt8183 definitions, eliminating duplicate code.
The patch caps ceph MDS request retries at 256 to avoid overflow of the 8‑bit retry counter, stopping further retries when the limit is exceeded.
Renames the preparation and issue handler functions for poll‑remove and file‑update requests to follow the io_<cmd>_prep / io_<cmd> naming pattern, making the io_uring codebase consistent.
Adds a guard in ocfs2_dlm_shutdown to skip cleanup when the DLM resource was never initialized, preventing a kernel crash after mount failures.
The commit relocates the calcs directory, which contains FPU code, into the DML directory to follow project guidelines, and fixes compilation issues when DCN is disabled.
Fixes handling of very fragmented attributes in NTFS3's attr_punch_hole by adding a call to ni_find_attr attr_b to locate the attribute correctly.

The patch fixes a memory leak that occurs when resolve_indirect_refs() aborts on error; it replaces ulist_free() with free_leaf_list() to also free inode lists attached via the aux field, and moves/simplifies free_leaf_list().
The patch edits spte.h in the KVM x86 MMU code to delete a duplicated phrase “be split be split”, leaving a single “be split”. It only changes a comment, not code logic.
Adds a create_pidcomm helper in perf timechart to consolidate duplicated allocation of per-pid communication structures.

The patch updates rxe_resp.c's read_reply() to correctly compute the memory region (mr) value when forming a READ reply, fixing a rare case where mr became zero and caused the rping benchmark to fail on long runs.

The patch modifies the bq25890 driver to use regulator_init_data only for the VBUS regulator, removing it from the VSYS regulator config before registration, preventing duplicate consumer supply registration that caused probe failure.

The patch corrects migrate_pages() handling of THP migration failures when the kernel returns -ENOSYS. It moves the failed THP from the "from" list to "ret_pages" to avoid double counting, and aligns the error handling for hugetlbfs pages, improving code clarity.

The patch adds acquisition of the RPM runtime power management wakelock around the PXP hardware cleanup performed during driver unbind, mirroring a similar change for suspend, to eliminate the “RPM wakelock ref not held during HW access” warning.
The patch updates the PSP_BL_CMD enumeration in the amdgpu driver to exactly match the definitions in the trusted OS, correcting a mismatch that could cause incorrect command handling.
The patch updates the bonding driver to copy IPv4/IPv6 source addresses using __struct_group() (struct_group) instead of raw memcpy, eliminating compiler warnings about reading beyond field size.
Adds a flag to mark a cancelled transmit as aborted and stops retrying, preventing hardware buffer overwrite that caused garbled CEC data.
The commit updates the MAINTAINERS file for the broadcom USB driver, replacing Al Cooper with Justin Chen as the internal maintainer and adding him as an upstream maintainer.
The patch extracts the timeout opcode implementations and related handling code from the main io_uring core into a dedicated source file, updating includes and build system accordingly.
The patch renames struct udl_drm_connector to udl_connector, removing the redundant _drm_ prefix, and adds a macro for upcasting from drm_connector. No functional changes are introduced.
The patch deletes the unused prototype __arch_set_user_pkey_access() from the x86/pkeys code because the function is neither defined nor referenced.
The patch removes the reg_from_user() and reg_to_user() helpers in KVM arm64 code and replaces their calls with the standard get_user()/put_user() primitives, simplifying the implementation.
The commit updates the net/dsa documentation, correcting several typographical, grammatical, and punctuation errors without altering code behavior.
The patch edits Documentation/process/changes.rst, replacing a hard‑coded version number (4.x) with the placeholder 'latest' so the document stays accurate for future kernel releases.
The patch removes the mutex lock/unlock around the bvalid IRQ handler in the Rockchip INNO USB2 PHY driver, asserting that clearing the IRQ is atomic and the lock is unnecessary.

Aligns tcp_bpf_recvmsg_parser() error handling with the TCP stack, returning correct error codes (e.g., sock_error, abort on shutdown) instead of EAGAIN, fixing mismatched behavior that caused bogus errors and latency for applications using BPF sockmap.
Adds a missing ida_free() (previously ida_simple_remove()) in the alcor_pci probe error path and replaces deprecated ida_simple_get()/remove() with ida_alloc()/ida_free().
The commit reverts a previous change that populated the DCN315 clock table using dcfclk values, because that caused a no‑read/underflow situation when dcfclk states are disabled.
The commit adds a debugfs file amdgpu_reset_level to the amdgpu driver, allowing users to select and block specific reset types, with the default disabling mode2 reset.

The patch modifies the KVM arm64 VGIC code so that when reading interrupt pending registers, it fetches the pending state from the physical distributor (or timer) for hardware‑mapped interrupts, correcting the mismatch where the virtual distributor reported wrong state.

The patch replaces manual bitwise manipulation of PLANE_WM_BLOCKS_MASK with REG_FIELD_PREP and REG_FIELD_GET macros, and updates skl_wm_level_from_reg_val to use REG_FIELD_GET, improving consistency and size safety.
Removes an unused forward declaration from pwm.h that was only required before a prior commit dropped the per‑chip dbg_show callback, cleaning up dead code.

The patch simplifies ipa_table_init_add() by replacing opcode and separate region IDs with two flags (filter and ipv6). It uses ipa_table_mem() to select the correct memory region and removes the assumption that a hashed table entry always exists.
The patch extracts all devlink‑related code from dsa.c and dsa2.c into a new devlink.c and adds a dedicated devlink.h, minimizing use of the generic dsa_priv.h and cleaning up the DSA driver files.

The patch corrects NR_FILE_MAPPED accounting for file/shmem huge pages by moving the __mod_lruvec_page_state() call to ensure it is not skipped, eliminating a race that caused inflated 'Mapped' values in /proc/meminfo.
The patch updates the io_uring poll‑cancel path to carry the current locking state (issue_flags) so that the cancellation functions can acquire the uring lock when needed.
Adds a compatible string entry for the Renesas RZ/V2L (R9A07G054) SoC in the Mali‑Bifrost GPU dt‑bindings documentation, updating the binding file to recognize this hardware.

Adds support for high userspace addresses in hugetlb mmap by using arch_get_mmap_base/end in hugetlb_get_unmapped_area, moving those macros to a common header. Fixes regression where hugetlb could return addresses above 48‑bit on ARM64 after prior commit.

The patch updates perf stat printing code so that most print functions receive a pointer to the existing struct outstate, adding the parameter to evlist__print_counters() and forwarding it to its child functions.
Adds missing le32_to_cpu() conversions and switches to %d for atomic_read() values in the habanalabs driver, correcting the printed output of out‑of‑sync and packet‑failure events.
Adds ACPI ID support to enumerate Cypress CCGX PD controller over designware I2C on AMD platforms, enabling kernel to recognize the client.
The commit replaces an outdated aer‑inject repository URL with the correct link referenced in the PCI AER documentation, updating the source code/comments accordingly.
Extracts a duplicated loop for patching entry fixups in PowerPC code into a new helper function do_patch_entry_fixups(), reducing repetition.

The commit updates the MMP DMA engine driver to stop using the deprecated '#dma-channels' DT property, switches to the standard 'dma-channels' property, and adds compatibility handling for older device trees.

Migrates MediaTek clock driver code to the new clk_hw API by replacing struct clk with struct clk_hw, updating related data structures and call sites via a coccinelle script, while keeping temporary bridges for compatibility.
The patch renames the struct pcie_port to dw_pcie_rp throughout the DesignWare PCIe core driver to align with the dw_ prefix used elsewhere, improving naming consistency.
The commit changes the DCN315 display driver to read its clock table from dcfclk instead of fclk and adds checks that an empty pmfw table does not produce invalid DAL clocks.
The commit updates kernel-doc comments in security/lsm_audit.c to describe the missing 'ab' parameter in dump_common_audit_data, eliminating documentation warnings.
The commit corrects a typo in the SC8180x pinctrl driver’s wakeirq_map where GPIO36 and GPIO37 shared the same wake IRQ number, assigning the proper wake IRQ to GPIO37 so it can generate interrupts.

The commit updates an outdated comment in the IPA network driver to reflect that command info entries are no longer allocated after a prior change, correcting documentation without altering code behavior.
The patch updates the at91 sama5d27_wlsom1 device tree to stop forcing the LDO2 regulator on by default, because no driver uses it.

The patch lowers the severity of a warning about unclaimed register accesses in the i915 uncore driver to debug level, keeping the message visible for developers while avoiding noisy warnings for harmless cases.
Reorganizes vgic attribute handling in KVM arm64 by moving early vgic_{get,set}_common_attr() calls into the default switch case and deduplicating related code, improving readability.
The patch changes the return handling in tve200_modeset_init() to assign a definite error code instead of an ambiguous zero, eliminating a smatch static‑analysis warning.
Adds support for the ADL‑S graphics device by inserting its PCI identifier into the i915 driver’s PCI ID table.

The patch removes the __func__ macro from dev_dbg calls in the Intel soundwire driver, letting dyndbg supply module and function info. It changes only the debug statements, leaving functional behavior unchanged.
The commit updates the AMD GPU display driver’s self‑refresh watermarks for the DCN3.14 hardware, applying new values supplied by the hardware team for all memory types.
The patch changes vfs_setxattr() to take a const pointer for the value argument, reflecting that the data is not modified, and removes the need for a const‑cast in ovl_do_setxattr().

Switches thunderbolt test suite to use kunit_test_suite() macro, avoiding module_init conflict, and updates Kconfig to enable the test when KUNIT_ALL_TESTS is set, allowing kunit_tool to run the tests.
Adds a new internal helper that checks a file range has no ordered extents and integrates it into fallocate, hole punching, zero‑range and reflink paths, ensuring the range is clean after locking.

The patch replaces kthread_stop() usage in i915 selftests with kthread_work and explicit signaling, because kthread_stop now asserts pending signals causing premature thread termination and test failures.
Extends the xdpsock BPF sample to let users set destination and source MAC addresses for transmit‑only mode via new -G/--tx-dmac and -H/--tx-smac options, preserving default MAC behavior.
Adjusts the printk format in the amd-xgbe driver from %hx to %x to match integer promotion rules, eliminating a clang -Wformat warning.
The patch modifies the MIPS jump_label branch range check to cast the upper bound to a signed long before comparison, ensuring a signed compare and avoiding warnings caused by negative offsets.
The patch rewrites SPI driver statistics to use per‑CPU u64_stats_t, eliminating many spin_lock_irqsave() calls and cutting interrupt handling latency.
Enables the GENERIC0_INT interrupt for graphics/compute pipes so the RLC can be signaled to access indirect registers that the CP cannot reach directly.
The patch removes the reg field from the r8a73a4_cpg structure, as it is only needed during init, and passes the register base pointer as a local variable to r8a73a4_cpg_register_clock().
Updates s10_ops_write_init() to use IS_ERR() instead of NULL when checking the return of stratix10_svc_allocate_memory(), because that function returns ERR_PTR() on error.
Adds a workaround that re‑reads the DPCD SUPPORTED_LINK_RATES at each eDP link training to restore the Parade PS8461E MUX’s link‑rate state after power‑down, preventing fallback to low‑quality mode.
The patch replaces manual swapping of two variables in net2280.c with the generic swap() helper, removing the now‑unused temporary variables, to silence Coccinelle warnings.
The patch eliminates the HW_VAR_H2C_FW_P2P_PS_OFFLOAD case from SetHwReg8188EU() and calls the underlying function directly, simplifying the driver and removing unused HAL layer code.
Adds a cap to the user‑provided data->block[0] in ismt_access() to stay within dma_buffer limits, preventing out‑of‑bounds writes.

The patch initializes the 'shared' flag in the NVMe namespace head before allocating a multipath disk, ensuring nvme_is_unique_nsid() correctly detects unique namespaces and prevents block device name collisions when multipath and shared namespaces are used.
Adds a BPF self‑test exercising __user pointer tags, verifying that programs accessing user memory are rejected with Permission denied.
Updates kernel documentation to state that SAVEKMSG_MAGIC[12] constants are not magic numbers, explaining their role in dumping dmesg to Chip RAM on Amiga with debug=ram.

The patch changes tfp410_fini() from returning an int (always zero) to returning void, updating its prototype and callers. It also notes future similar changes for i2c and platform driver remove callbacks.
Adds a null‑pointer check for sta_rates in mt7615_sta_rate_tbl_update to avoid dereferencing when minstrel_ht_update_rates fails to allocate the rates array.
Adds a YAML device‑tree binding file describing the LoongArch CPU interrupt controller’s 14 IRQs, enabling platforms to represent the wiring in DT.
The patch changes batman-adv's interface traversal to stop assuming iflink indices are globally unique, adding checks for netns and handling special cases like vxcan_get_iflink returning 0.

The commit corrects the pinctrl driver for Nuvoton wpcm450 so that the SCS3SEL and KBCCSEL multiplex selection bits, which use inverted logic, are interpreted correctly, fixing the GPIO/special‑function selection behavior.
The patch corrects the constant used in a compile‑time size check for the TX side of kTLS in the mlx5e driver, replacing the wrong value with TLS_DRIVER_STATE_SIZE_TX.
The patch changes do_sys_name_to_handle() to take a const‑qualified path argument, improving const‑correctness in the kernel.
The patch replaces dev_err calls in the Qualcomm QMP UFS PHY probe with dev_err_probe, which auto‑handles -EPROBE_DEFER, logs the error name, and records the defer reason for debugfs.
Removes a redundant word from a comment in the bcache driver, cleaning up documentation.
Implements a GETVXATTR operation in the Ceph client, enabling direct queries to the MDS for directory and file virtual extended attributes, supporting JSON and legacy formats.
The patch deletes the irq_prepare_beacon_tasklet member from recv_priv in the r8188eu driver because it is never referenced, cleaning up dead code.
Adds ability for the Intel SOF ES8336 ASoC driver to use a separate GPIO line for headphone control, allowing independent speaker and headphone switching.
Adds a Qualcomm display clock controller driver for SM6125 platforms, enabling display drivers to probe and manage their clocks.
The patch adds a runtime warning in ACPICA’s executer when a sleep longer than 10 ms occurs, to highlight potential boot‑time delays.
Demotes the "Cannot find parent device" message from error to warning for macvtap on batadv when moved to another netns, updating the text to clarify that the sanity check was skipped.
Adds a NULL‑pointer guard in amdgpu_smu_stb_debug_fs_init so the function safely returns when the SMU block is not enabled, preventing a crash.
Adds a check in __nvme_fc_abort_outstanding_ios() to restart the NVMe-FC admin queue when required, fixing a condition where the controller could not handle admin requests and caused I/O hangs.

The patch introduces a new socket option SO_RCVMARK so that the packet mark (SO_MARK) is delivered in ancillary data via recvmsg(), and renames sock_recv_ts_and_drops() to sock_recv_cmsgs() for clearer semantics.
The patch deletes the redundant word 'new' from comments in the rtl8192e driver, cleaning up duplicated wording without changing any code logic.
The commit deletes the OMAP debug‑leds driver source and its Kconfig entry, removing code that has been unselectable for years, thereby cleaning the ARM/omap tree.
The commit corrects underline lengths in Documentation/security/SCTP.rst so that 'make htmldocs' no longer emits 'title underline too short' warnings.
Adds static qualifier to internal symbols in arm64 cpu_errata.c to silence sparse warnings, ensuring they are not exported globally.

The patch adds a condition so the driver only sets the scdc_enabled flag when the HDMI interface supports HDMI 1.4 or higher, preventing attempts to disable SCDC on Pi0‑3 where the SCDC registers do not exist, thus avoiding invalid register accesses and warnings.
The commit updates the lis3lv02d I2C driver to use the newer .probe_new() callback instead of the old .probe, because the driver does not need the i2c_device_id argument.
The patch updates the MSM display (MDSS) device‑tree binding by removing an interrupt‑flags cell that was incorrectly documented, because the MDSS interrupt provider supplies only a single cell.

The patch restores proper initialization of engine workaround lists for Gen2‑3 i915 platforms, which were left uninitialized after a prior helper‑signature change, preventing crashes or misbehavior on those older GPUs.
The patch deletes an obsolete comment in btrfs_search_slot() that described old extent buffer locking behavior, which is no longer relevant after the transition to rw semaphores.
Adds two DPCD bit fields from the eDP 1.5 spec to enable PSR2 support in the DRM driver, fixes a typo, and documents the new fields.
The commit removes duplicate calls to ras_late_init in the HDP RAS block of the amdgpu DRM driver, cleaning up unnecessary initialization.
The patch removes an unnecessary cast from the result of of_device_get_match_data() in the j721e PCI driver, because the function already returns void*; the change is purely a code cleanup.

The patch makes tcp_cdg_release() idempotent, allowing multiple calls without freeing already‑released memory, thus avoiding a double‑free when MPTCP invokes tcp_disconnect() on an already disconnected flow.
The patch modifies the v4l2 control reference structure to allocate memory for its internal arrays, preparing the core to let drivers resize those arrays later.
Updates the STM32 device tree for DHCOM to use MCO2 as the RMII ETHRX clock instead of ETHCK_K, freeing PLL4_P to run at 100 MHz, improving SD/MMC speed and reducing EMI.

Adds runtime WARN_ON_ONCE checks in the qcom-qmp-pcie PHY driver probe to ensure required configuration masks (pwrdn_ctrl and phy_status) are provided, catching missing settings during driver initialization.
Adds a compatible string to the AST2600 EVB A1 device tree, enabling kernel to recognize the board.
The patch adds an assertion in clear_em_logging() to verify that the caller holds a write lock on the extent map tree, ensuring proper locking before merging extent map entries.

The patch changes rcu_tasks_trace_pregp_step() to IPI each CPU, placing the current running task on the holdout list and recording its RCU‑Tasks‑Trace read‑side state, ensuring running tasks are considered during grace‑period processing.
The patch updates the scale min and max macro definitions for the BMA400 accelerometer driver so that each range’s sensitivity matches 1 LSB, correcting previously incorrect values.

The patch adjusts the manual packet extraction logic in the sparx5 driver so that packets whose length is not a multiple of 4 are processed correctly; it stops the checksum from being read past the packet data and ensures proper endian handling.

The patch simplifies vmalloc's find_va_links() by deleting a superfluous comparison that checks whether the target address is above or below a vmap_area, relying on the invariant that each area's start ≤ end.

The commit adds a central definition for the 'linux,input-type' property in the dt-bindings input.yaml file and updates all existing bindings to reference this definition, consolidating documentation.
The patch changes a driver function's declared return type from bool to int to reflect that it actually returns an error code, updating the prototype and related calls accordingly.
The commit corrects a spelling mistake in a comment within the selftests/vm/pkeys test suite, changing the typo to the proper word without altering code logic.
The patch replaces calls to call_rcu() with call_rcu_hurry() in the RCU sync code to avoid the power‑saving induced slowdown, restoring the previous faster behavior.
The commit extends the Qualcomm socinfo driver by adding entries for additional SoCs (SM8350, SC8280XP, SM8450) and PMICs (SA8540P, etc.), enabling the kernel to recognize these platforms.
The patch replaces the multiline macro vt6655_mac_word_reg_bits_on with an equivalent static inline function to satisfy checkpatch, improving readability and avoiding macro limitations.
The patch updates the 8250_omap serial driver to advance the Tx queue via the generic uart_xmit_advance() helper, replacing driver‑specific code for better consistency and robustness.
The patch removes calls to bio_advance() in __split_and_process_bio() and __send_duplicate_bios() because earlier loop removal made them unnecessary, cleaning up dead code in the dm subsystem.

The patch extends perf's hypervisor thread handling by adding a guest_cpu identifier, allowing perf to map a host thread to the specific guest CPU (VCPU) it was executing, using information from the id_index.
Enables InterTouch (RMI4) support for ThinkPad P1 G3 by adjusting the synaptics driver, allowing the touchpad to function where it was previously disabled.
The patch adds the hardware workaround Wa_16013835468 to the i915 driver, handling a PSR2 issue when a display mode has delayed vblank, based on Intel bug specifications.
The patch changes several static initialization tables and the rtl8xxxu_rfregs array in the rtl8xxxu Wi‑Fi driver to be declared const, marking them as read‑only data.
The commit updates the mt8195 pinctrl device‑tree binding YAML to allow pinctrl groups to contain subnodes, enabling multiple pin configurations per group and adds an example usage.

The patch adds a hardware‑presence check before probing the Xilinx ZynqMP SHA driver, preventing it from loading on platforms without the required hardware, and refactors driver registration with module_platform_driver while adding a firmware dependency.
Adds a version field to the edif BSG structure, implements a version check, and removes dead interfaces and fields, cleaning up the qla2xxx driver.
Fixes a spelling typo in a comment within the RDMA/opa_vnic driver code.
The commit introduces new device tree binding definitions for the Qualcomm SM6350 camera clock controller, enabling the kernel to describe this hardware in DT files.

The patch expands the rtl8xxxu driver’s chip‑cut detection to cover letters A‑P, replacing the previous fallback that printed "unknown" for versions beyond E, thus correctly recognising all known chip revisions.

The patch separates the handling of HK_FLAG_WQ and HK_FLAG_DOMAIN in the workqueue housekeeping cpumask, giving each its own cpumask and forbidding mixed flag calls, to enable future runtime cpuset modifications.
The commit updates the MAINTAINERS file to replace John Garry's email address for the arm64 perf tooling section, reflecting his new contact information.
The patch removes an explicit .owner assignment in the Sunplus SPL2SW Ethernet driver because the core network stack sets it automatically, eliminating a platform_no_drv_owner.cocci warning.
The patch adds power‑management callbacks to the Microchip PCI1XXXX SPI driver, storing the device configuration on suspend and restoring it on resume, thus enabling proper suspend/resume handling.
The commit corrects the baud‑rate table in the ftdi_sio USB‑serial driver so that a 300 bps rate is no longer incorrectly mapped to 9600 bps, restoring the original behavior.
Adds support for PERF_SAMPLE_DATA_SRC on AMD by converting IBS raw data into the generic perf_mem_data_src structure for tools like perf mem and c2c.
Adds a free() for the orom_data buffer when ice_read_flash_module() fails, eliminating a memory leak in ice_get_orom_civd_data().
Adds two BPF self‑tests that verify read‑only map value pointers are rejected when passed to global functions and that the MEM_RDONLY flag is correctly enforced.

Adds a sysfs "label" attribute for sensors with known locations, removes the non‑standard "location" attribute and the corresponding struct field, updating handling for accelerometers, IMUs and light sensors.
The commit corrects the fsl,clk-source property in the lx2160a device‑tree CAN node, changing it to a uint8 representation using /bits/8 <0> to eliminate a build‑time warning about property length.
The commit updates the MAINTAINERS file to add Roman Gushchin as a co‑maintainer for the memory controller subsystem, reflecting his contributions and responsibilities.

The patch changes libiscsi so that the iscsi class connection object is added to sysfs only after its driver data (dd_data) is initialized, preventing a NULL dereference when userspace reads attributes. It also deletes the now‑unused iscsi_create_conn() helper.
