The patch replaces the fc_tos field in fib_config with the new dscp_t type and adds validation that IPv4 routes with ECN bits set in rtm_tos are rejected, aligning route acceptance with IPv4's ECN‑masking behavior.
The patch removes an unused 'task' argument from x86 arch_prctl helper functions, because these functions only operate on the current task, simplifying the API.
The commit removes the EXPORT_SYMBOL for kthread_blkcg, limiting its visibility because it is only used internally by blk‑cgroup code.
Adds three regmap_field helper functions (set_bits, clear_bits, test_bits) as static inline or regular functions to simplify bit operations, extending the regmap API.
The commit updates kernel documentation to highlight existing count API calls for fwnode and device property arrays, making developers aware of shortcuts for determining array element counts.
Adds checks in AMDGPU discovery to validate table signatures, checksums and existence before use, and temporarily disables the MALL table.
The patch makes many display driver functions static and removes an unused function to silence -Wmissing-prototypes warnings, improving internal linkage and code cleanliness.
The patch adds a missing free() for the fw_control_ex structure when pm8001_chip_fw_flash_update_build() fails, eliminating a memory leak in the pm8001 SCSI driver.
The patch adds a NULL‑pointer check after kzalloc() in the SGI IP22 MIPS driver, returning an error if allocation fails, thus avoiding dereferencing a NULL pointer.
The commit removes the HMM_BO_SHARE enum/value from the atomisp driver because the HMM buffer object code never supports it, cleaning up dead/unused code.

Adds a NULL‑pointer check before iterating over job->bo during error cleanup in v3d_lookup_bos and removes an unnecessary null test inside the cleanup loop, preventing crashes when BO allocation fails.

The patch rewrites the mixel,mipi-dsi-phy device‑tree binding from plain‑text to a JSON‑schema representation, adding assigned‑clocks, assigned‑clock‑parents, assigned‑clock‑rates and requiring a power‑domains property to satisfy dtbs_check.
Adds checks in the wilc1000 Wi‑Fi driver to verify the IEEE80211_P2P_ATTR_CHANNEL_LIST attribute is large enough for struct wilc_attr_oper_ch, preventing out‑of‑bounds writes.
The patch corrects the port‑selection logic for sending VBT packets on dual‑link DSI by using the per‑port bitmask stored in intel_dsi->ports, fixing incorrect packet routing.

The commit modifies the thermal governor's userspace code to replace a deprecation warning with an informational message advising use of netlink thermal events, keeping the governor functional while reducing alarming output.
The patch modifies the MSM DSI PHY driver to replace parent clock name strings with direct clk_hw pointers, eliminating string formatting and lookup overhead.
The patch updates the xdp_bpf2bpf self‑test by deleting the obsolete CHECK macro and replacing its uses with the existing ASSERT* macros, cleaning up the test code.

The patch updates the rkisp1 driver to let the resizer sink pad accept any color space, propagate it unchanged, and enforce Rec 601 encoding and full‑range quantization when the input is Bayer in pass‑through mode.
The patch deletes the IWL_DEVICE_BZ_COMMON macro from the iwlwifi configuration code and inlines its single use into the IWL_DEVICE_BZ macro, simplifying the macro definitions.
The patch modifies the rcutorture torture.sh script, raising the default extra memory allocation from 1 GB to 2 GB so that KASAN‑enabled tests have enough memory.

The patch updates the device‑tree compatible strings for SSD130x I2C display controllers, removing the legacy “fb‑i2c” suffixes and adding newer, bus‑agnostic strings, while marking the old ones as deprecated.
The patch modifies the AMDGPU PSP driver termination code to always release allocated memory, even when the unload operation fails, eliminating a memory leak.
Adds speed‑bin handling for MSM A6xx driver to detect different A619 GPU SKUs and apply appropriate frequency ranges based on the hardware bin.
The patch moves the STM32MP15_BSEC_NUM_LOWER definition into the STM32 ROMEM configuration, preparing the codebase for the upcoming STM32MP SoC variant.
The patch updates the mount ID‑mapping code to call the new type‑safe helper functions in mapped_fsgid() and mapped_fsuid(), replacing the old non‑type‑safe helpers that are slated for removal.
The commit changes the v4l2‑ctrls read‑only array range from a stack variable to a static definition, removing runtime allocation and shrinking the generated object code.
Removes obsolete s390-specific declarations from compat_linux.h and tidies the header after switching to a generic UID16 implementation.
The patch removes the unused, deprecated <linux/of_gpio.h> include from Mediatek DRM drivers, as the code never references symbols from that header.
Adds a network Ethernet driver for the Sunplus SP7021 SoC, introducing new source files and registration code to support the hardware in the kernel.

The patch fixes a use‑after‑free in dvb‑core caused by a race between dvb_demux_open and dvb_dmxdev_release. It adds an exit‑flag check in dvb_demux_open and serializes the flag and sync with dmxdev->mutex in release, stopping a second open while the device is closing.
The patch removes an accidental duplicate definition of tcp_wmem_schedule, which caused compilation errors in the TCP subsystem.
The patch adds a check for the return value of alloc_workqueue() in nintendo_hid_probe() and introduces error handling when allocation fails, preventing a null‑pointer dereference.
Adds a helper to reset architecture‑specific per‑rmid storage and calls it when a new rmid is first allocated, preventing hidden state from persisting across rmid reuse or filesystem mounts.
The patch replaces explicit struct list_head initialization with the LIST_HEAD() macro in the Hyper-V utils driver, simplifying the code and improving readability.
